name: sockets_fix_and_show
description: VI-3b: on a Blank pipeline project, present draws with engine://passthrough. With a Cube and a Deferred geometry pass (the Graph's palette from Add material pass..., GL-5c; the engine keeps running, MC-1s), its albedo and normal images are dropped on present's variadic band. A click on binding 1's socket writes PELICAN_PASSTHROUGH_INPUT=1 into present's shader.defines, and the viewport shows the normals; the socket is marked (shown). Fix sockets copies engine://passthrough into shaders/present.frag with its variadic line replaced by one declaration per connected input, and moves present onto the copy, defines kept: the sockets are named in_render_material_pass_albedo and in_render_material_pass_normal and the viewport shows the same colour. Make sockets variadic puts the line back, and the band returns.
